blocks.text: LUCENA CITY, Quezon — Taal Volcano in Batangas logged a minor phreatomagmatic eruption Wednesday morning, generating a plume rising about 250 meters above its main crater lake, according to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs). In a bulletin issued shortly after 11 a.m., Phivolcs said the eruption occurred between 10:07 a.m. and 10:09 a.m. on Taal Volcano Island (TVI), located at the center of Taal Lake. Phivolcs said the volcano’s IP surveillance camera captured the event.
